notes.title: A Tapestry of Old and New Titles! RPG Maker Festival 2025 Begins! Celebrate Over
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/b4645591bfd53a650090cbdd251797c26a158406.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]About RPG Maker Festival 2025[/b][/h1]
Maker Day (Tsukuru no Hi, February 15th) is the day for recognizing and spreading the joy of making games! 
To celebrate this day, we are holding the online event 'RPG Maker Festival' again this year!

The "RPG Maker Festival" is a grand event with the theme of "Creators and players, everyone is the star!"
There'll be new releases and lots of discounts for RPG Maker products, DLCs, and a large number of games created with RPG Maker.
This year, the number of participating titles is [b]1074 games[/b] - a record for the event! Don't miss your chance to discover new masterpieces and make some great purchases.

Additionally 2025 represents the 5th anniversary for RPG Maker MZ, the 10th anniversary for RPG Maker MV, and the 25th anniversary for RPG Maker 2000! To celebrate these anniversaries, RPG Maker Festival 2025  is spread out over 2 weeks due to all we have planned! We hope you will be with us for the whole journey!


■RPG Maker Festival 2025 Dates
Phase 1: February 4th, 2025  until February 11th 2025. 
Phase 2: February 11th 2025 until February 18th 2025

■Phase 1 Event URL
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025[/url]


[h1][b]Part One Events
RPG Maker VX Ace Available For Free[/b][/h1]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/56da34f7c8f2288ed6423a5c4b7436d17d44d9e2.png[/img]
It’s our pleasure to announce that for a limited time, RPG MakerVX Ace, with global sales exceeding 500,000 copies,  will be available for free download!
It set the roadmap for the actors, items, database and other functions that carry through to RPG Maker MZ today! Even today many fans love the feel provided by RPG Maker VX Ace! We hope many people will give it a try during this limited opportunity!

■ Free Download Period
February 4th until February 11th, 2025
･URL： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025[/url]


[h1][b]Big Sales! RPG Maker MZ 55％ Off, RPG Maker MV 93％ Off
[/b][/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/ef51407d44f485052ef03984944cffa1a4a224d8.png[/img]
RPG Maker MZ is discounted 55％ on Steam to celebrate it’s 5th anniversary! RPG Maker MV, celebrating it’s 10th anniversary,  will be available at the amazing value of 93％ off on Steam!
Additionally, a major update is coming very soon for RPG Maker MZ, making it even easier to use!
And for those who are already owners of some RPG Maker titles, there’s special celebration available with even more discounts!

February 4th until February 11th, 2025

[h2][b]RPG Maker Game Celebrations
[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/0b30ddf0f8f8a93e0f89bd6bded9a8b443df3193.png[/img]
RPG Maker is more than just the engine; it’s also all the games that the community has made over the many years! To celebrate these creations, event pages have been created on both Steam and DLsite!
More than 1000 games are participating!
You’ll be able to find indie experiences from all over the world, many of which will also be on sale as a part of the RPG Maker Festival experience!

・Steam Event Page： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025[/url]
・Introduction Video for Participating Titles :  [url=https://youtu.be/XU2cEwwKbyU]https://youtu.be/XU2cEwwKbyU[/url]


[b][h2]ACTION GAME MAKER: Release Date Announcement & New Trailer on 2025/6/16!
[/h2][/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/863f164cbc880c65b9e2e3a2c40ee218a83c396f.png[/img]
The latest entry in the Maker franchise, ACTION GAME MAKER will announce it’s release date on February 17th, 2025!　And that’s not all: a brand new trailer will be released showing never before seen footage!
・ACTION GAME MAKER URL：[url=https://youtu.be/JSjN67Bc_jo]https://youtu.be/JSjN67Bc_jo[/url]

Designed to allow anyone to make 2D action games without programming and built on top of Godot Engine, ACTION GAME MAKER represents a new step forward for the Maker franchise.
And with plenty of included assets, you’ll be able to get started on your game making journey!
Please visit the Steam page and wishlist it now!

・ACTION GAME MAKER Steam page：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987180/ACTION_GAME_MAKER/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987180/ACTION_GAME_MAKER/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN[/url]


[b][h2]RPG Maker 2000 DLC Reborn
[/h2][/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/4833f34677f6988078129e17a786e29b381ea8b3.png[/img]
It’s been an amazing 25 years since RPG Maker 2000 first released! To celebrate, we’re bringing back some content that was released with the RPG Maker 2000 Handbook specifically for RPG Maker MZ!
Tile sets and characters, animations, sound effects and voice lines and so much more are included! And all remastered for use with RPG Maker MZ! In addition, the original assets in their RPG Maker 2000/2003 compatible format are included as well!
Whether you’re a collector who never had the opportunity to get the Handbook or you just like the look of these assets, this is an amazing opportunity!

・RPG Maker 2000 Handbook Assets Steam Page：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478100/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Maker_2000_Handbook_Assets/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478100/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Maker_2000_Handbook_Assets/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN[/url]


[h1][b]Phase Two Events[/b][/h1]
During phase two of RPG Maker Festival 2025, the discounts and content sharing will continue! We’re not prepared to release that information, so we hope you will remain excited until it is unveiled at the start of phase two!

notes.title: Registration Has Begun! RPG Maker Festival Returns in 2025!
notes.notes:
The RPG Maker Festival has returned for 2025!

▼What is RPG Maker Festival?
February 25th is “Maker Day”, the day we celebrated all things RPG Maker.
And we celebrate by holding the RPG Maker Festival!

RPG Maker Festival celebrates all games made with all versions of RPG Maker and Pixel Game Maker! We want to showcase and introduce more people to the wonderful games that have been made with RPG Maker, and connect as many creators and players together as possible. The more connected we are, the more fun there is to be had!

There’s many anniversaries this year, so the theme for RPG Maker Festival 2025 is “A Tapestry of Old and New Titles”!  


▼RPG Maker Festival 2025: Participants Wanted!
We’re currently looking for developers and publishers who’d like to participant in RPG Maker Festival 2025!

notes.title: A classic RPG Maker engine, the same one used to create Pokémon Uranium, is completely free on Steam this week
notes.notes: There was a time in my early teenagehood where I was so entrenched in anime and JRPG brain rot that I convinced myself I was talented enough to make a game all of my own. That never happened, of course, but the one thing I do remember from that time was how much fun I had poking around in RPG Maker. It's a great little bit of software that's birthed some bangers like Corpse Party, To the Moon and Mad Father. And right now, one of its older versions is totally free on Steam... Read more.

The RPG Maker Festival is an annual Steam Sale Event that saw its first occurring in February 2022. It is dedicated to the RPG Maker series, a non-coding engine series well loved by many indie and hobbyist developers from around the globe. 
Not only will the engines be discounted greatly, the 2023 event will also be joined by over 450 RPG Maker-made game titles created by its enthusiastic and eager fan community, including worldly-acclaimed titles such as The Witch's House MV and LISA: The Painful!

[b]45% OFF on RPG Maker MZ, and 85% OFF on RPG Maker MV！[/b]
The most current RPG Maker title, RPG Maker MZ, will be discounted up to 45% OFF in the 2023 event - the deepest discount to date.
Meanwhile, RPG Maker MV, will be discounted up to 85％ OFF. 
For users who already own other RPG Maker titles, there will also be special bundles available too.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30532/2023_MZ_Festival_SPECIAL/

[b]Release of the 3D Character Converter Tool on Steam![/b]
The 3D Character Converter is a convenient mini-app that can quickly convert humanoid-shaped VRM models into 2D character sprite assets compatible with RPG Maker series. Users can either import custom-made or commercially available VRM models into the converter for conversion. The app can output a total of 5 types of map walker sprites, 18 types of side-view battle character (aka SV-Battler) sprites, and the model’s faces for use as character portraits in dialogue boxes common in RPGs. 

Although the 3D Character Converter app was originally designed for the currently in development RPG Maker Unite, there are also options that would allow the converter to output 2D assets compatible with RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ. The developers hope that the early release of this app can provide RPG Maker users a different means of creating game assets for their games.

(What is VRM: A platform-independent file format designed for use with 3D characters and avatars in the VR era. (Please refer to the [url=https://vrm-consortium.org/en/]VRM Consortium[/url] for detail))

[b]RPG Maker 3D Character Converter Product Spec

[i]PiXel ScaLer[/i] is a simple but powerful tool that can enlarge and convert pixel arts into higher resolution illustrations. Already released on RPG Maker Unite’s official site, it will now also be available for download on Steam for simpler app management. The tool supports many resolutions which makes it suitable to use with RPG Maker MZ and MV, as well as the RPG Maker Unite currently in development.　

※PiXel ScaLer is a product developed by Nononotyaya-san - who has granted Gotcha Gotcha Games the rights to distribute it as an official tool of RPG Maker series.
※(The previous PiXel ScaLer will continue to be available for download at the author’s sites. Users of the previous version of PiXel ScaLer can also continue to use it without concerns)

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - RPG Maker XP
notes.notes:
RPG Maker XP is Now Available on Steam!

RPG MAKER XP is equipped with the Ruby Game Scripting System (RGSS1), based on the Ruby language and customized especially for this program. Though mastering RGSS may take some time, it is a powerful tool in fully customizing your game. You can use RGSS to change how your game looks, feels, sounds and plays. If programming is just not your forte, you can turn to a wide variety of user-created scripts that's shared within the RPG Maker community.
